items.name: Florida State University
items.prescreen_deadline: Solo video (1-2 min, any style) uploaded to the FSU portal one week before your audition: 2026-10-21, 2027-01-06 or 2027-02-03
items.app_deadline: Early Action (Florida residents) 2026-10-15; Regular 2026-12-01; dance supplemental due 2026-10-14 for the Oct 28 audition and 2026-12-08 for the Jan and Feb auditions
items.audition: In person at FSU on 2026-10-28, 2027-01-13 or 2027-02-10, with ballet, contemporary and improv classes plus the solo video, and dates close when they fill.
items.scholarships: Bright Futures applies at FSU as a Florida public university; the dance page's out-of-state BFA tuition waiver does not apply to Florida residents.
items.why_john: The top-name contemporary BFA in your own state at in-state tuition, and they let you dance your own solo choreography.
items.watch_out: The dance supplemental for the October 28 audition is due 2026-10-14, Early Action closes 2026-10-15, the School of Dance won't consider any application after 2026-12-08, Early Decision isn't allowed, and the solo must be filmed in a studio in class clothes, not pulled from a recent competition or performance.

items.name: University of Florida
items.program: BFA in Dance (BA in Dance also offered, no audition)
items.app_deadline: Early Decision Oct 15 (binding), Early Action Nov 1, Regular Jan 15; audition registration due 1 week before the audition
items.audition: In person at the Nadine McGuire Pavilion on 2026-11-06 or 2027-01-29, with contemporary, ballet, contemporary African diasporic dance, composition and a faculty interview; to audition by video you also do a virtual interview, and you email two letters, a resume and a headshot by 2026-10-30 or 2027-01-22.
items.scholarships: Bright Futures applies at UF as a Florida public university; the dance admissions page lists no dance scholarships.
items.why_john: A flagship degree at in-state cost, with a BFA built around contemporary dance, contemporary ballet and choreographing your own work.
items.watch_out: Early Decision binds you to UF even if the BFA turns you down, BFA decisions can land after UF's general admission decision, and the audition includes African diasporic dance that comp training doesn't usually cover.

items.name: University of South Florida
items.program: BFA in Dance Performance (BA in Dance Studies, no audition)
items.app_deadline: USF admission application by March 1; in-person audition registration (opened 2026-09-01) closes 48 hours before each date or when full
items.audition: In person in Tampa on 2026-10-23, 2026-11-20, 2027-01-15 or 2027-02-12 with two technique classes and a solo of 90 seconds or less, or by video on Acceptd (Sept 5 to Feb 26), or at a recruiting event such as NYCDA or Universal Ballet Competition.
items.scholarships: USF says to apply early to be considered for departmental support, and Bright Futures applies as a Florida public university.
items.why_john: An hour from home at in-state cost, four audition dates, and a video option if your schedule gets slammed.
items.watch_out: The BFA has you pick a ballet or modern emphasis with heavy study in both, you must place at least Level I in ballet and contemporary, and the Performance track has a second admission step.

items.name: New World School of the Arts (Miami Dade College)
items.audition: The page lists in-person auditions in downtown Miami on Nov 14 (Day of Dance), Jan 23, Feb 27 and Mar 20, with modern warm-up, improv, ballet, jazz, a one-minute solo and an interview, or you can email a video.
items.why_john: A conservatory BFA in downtown Miami that tests modern, ballet and jazz and gives you a one-minute solo to show what you've got.
items.watch_out: The page says 2026-2027, but its Friday dates match the 2025-26 calendar, so confirm the real dates with mlburns@mdc.edu; NWSA is a partnership of Miami Dade College, Miami-Dade schools and UF, so ask who grants the degree and how Bright Futures applies.

items.name: Jacksonville University
items.app_deadline: Audition materials due 2027-01-15, 2027-02-19 or 2027-04-02
items.audition: Live audition on a JU audition day with ballet barre and center, contemporary and an improv exercise; video is only for special cases like international students, and a regional or national recruiting event JU attends can count instead.
items.scholarships: Artist fellowships based on merit and need run from partial to full tuition, you apply for them when you apply for admission, and FAFSA is recommended by Feb 1.
items.why_john: A private school that can cover up to full tuition for a talented dancer, with ballet, modern and jazz at its core.
items.watch_out: The page says these deadlines are for 2026-27 entry, but the dates fall in 2027, so confirm they mean fall 2027; Bright Futures status was not confirmed on an official JU page.

items.name: Palm Beach Atlantic University
items.app_deadline: Application and audition done at least six weeks before the first term
items.audition: Live ballet and modern classes, a solo in any style you choose and a faculty interview; the page lists Nov 20, Dec 12, Feb 12, Mar 6 and Apr 17 without years, and you can send a video for provisional review.
items.scholarships: Dance scholarships go to a limited number of students and require a 3.0 dance GPA and auditioning for Dance Ensemble every semester, and PBA's own site confirms Bright Futures can be used there.
items.why_john: A smaller private BFA where your solo can be in any style and Bright Futures still helps with tuition.
items.watch_out: Audition dates have no year printed (the weekdays match 2026-27), and you need a separate dance application with a teacher recommendation and an essay.

items.name: Florida Southern College
items.program: BFA in Dance Performance and Choreography (BA in Dance Studies also offered)
items.app_deadline: Early Action priority Nov 1, Regular priority Dec 1 (from the admissions page; fall 2027 dates not separately posted)
items.audition: Live on campus in Lakeland with ballet barre and center, contemporary modern phrases, improv, a 90-second solo and an interview, on 2027-01-23 or 2027-02-20 (admitted students only) or 2027-03-19 (Preview Day), with video possible if you can't get there.
items.scholarships: The BFA and BA audition doubles as a dance scholarship audition, and admissions says every applicant is also considered for an academic scholarship of up to $26,000 a year.
items.why_john: Forty minutes from Orlando, a degree with choreography in the name, and the audition doubles as your scholarship shot.
items.watch_out: The 2026-10-05 Theatre and Dance Day audition has passed and two of the remaining dates are for admitted students only, so apply early.

items.name: The University of Tampa
items.audition: Audition and interview by appointment with the dance director (slemarquand@ut.edu), and UT's theatre page says dance auditions can be digital or in person at an admissions open house.
items.scholarships: UT links to a Musical Theatre, Theatre and Dance Scholarships page; amounts not confirmed.
items.why_john: A dance degree aimed at teaching in studios and community programs, which builds right on what you already do with the little kids.
items.watch_out: It's a BA focused on teaching, not a performance BFA, majors face a second-year review in ballet, contemporary and jazz, and no 2027 dates are posted.

items.name: Valencia College
items.app_deadline: Audition application due 2027-04-16 (for the 2027-04-24 audition) or 2027-06-18 (for the 2027-06-26 audition)
items.audition: An in-person technique class at East Campus with ballet barre and center, a modern combination and a jazz combination, no solo needed, and decisions within two weeks.
items.scholarships: Bright Futures applies at Florida public state colleges, and the dance page lists no dance scholarships.
items.why_john: The cheapest way to keep training at home in Orlando for two years, then audition for a university BFA as a junior.
items.watch_out: The AA does not guarantee a spot at any university dance program, and UCF (Valencia's usual transfer partner) has no dance major, so you'd still need to audition into FSU, UF or USF later.

items.name: University of Central Florida
items.audition: The minor takes an audition once a semester and wants intermediate to advanced dancers; contact Judi Siegfried (judi.siegfried@ucf.edu) for dates.
items.scholarships: Bright Futures applies at UCF as a Florida public university.
items.why_john: If you'd rather major in something else and keep dancing at home, this pre-professional minor is right in Orlando.
items.watch_out: UCF has no dance BA or BFA, only the minor, so it won't give you a dance degree.

items.name: The Juilliard School
items.audition: Prescreen videos go in through the application portal, results come out December 22, and the dancers who pass are invited to an in-person callback in New York on Feb 21, 27, 28 or March 1, 2027.
items.scholarships: Juilliard admits without looking at your ability to pay, and every dollar it awards requires the scholarship and financial aid forms, so plan on need-based aid rather than talent money.
items.why_john: John, your contemporary work and your habit of building your own solos are exactly what this program trains, and getting a callback here would tell you a lot about where you stand.
items.watch_out: They take only 20 to 24 dancers a year, they want at least three years of ballet plus modern or contemporary training, they expect partnering strength, and they do not accept late dance applications.

items.name: The Ailey School / Fordham University
items.prescreen_deadline: Ailey dance application, with two ballet photos (tendu a la seconde and first arabesque), due 2026-11-01
items.audition: Both the Ailey dance application and the Fordham Common App are due November 1, Ailey invites the strongest applicants to audition for a $45 fee, and the 2027 tour dates were still marked as coming in October when checked.
items.scholarships: Fordham handles all aid, including need-based grants and merit awards for artistic and academic potential, so file both the CSS Profile and the FAFSA.
items.why_john: You would get serious modern training plus a full university degree in New York, which suits a dancer who already choreographs and teaches.
items.watch_out: The November 1, 2026 deadline comes fast, Ailey says it no longer accepts video auditions, it charges a $280 yearly physical therapy fee, and Fordham is private-school expensive.

items.name: New York University, Tisch School of the Arts
items.audition: Start with a timed video prescreen class (ballet center and contemporary). If you pass, you book a callback within 48 hours: Nov 13, 2026 for ED I, or for Regular Decision Jan 30, 2027 in Chicago or LA or Feb 5 or 6, 2027 in New York.
items.scholarships: The dance requirements page gives no scholarship details and only links to NYU financial aid and cost of attendance.
items.why_john: Tisch leans contemporary and puts real weight on dancers who make their own work, which is the kind of dancer you already are.
items.watch_out: NYU is one of the most expensive schools in the country, the dance page names no talent scholarships, and you should allow up to 10 days after sending the Common App before you get access to the prescreen portal.

items.name: Purchase College, SUNY (Conservatory of Dance)
items.app_deadline: 2027-02-01 (portfolio materials by 2027-02-08)
items.audition: In-person on campus Feb 6, 12, 20 or 26, 2027, after you apply, upload a dance resume and photo, and pay a $65 fee: ballet class, modern and contemporary combinations and improv, then finalists do a 90-second solo and a short interview.
items.scholarships: The dance page lists no dance-specific scholarships and only links to the general college scholarships page.
items.why_john: Purchase is a public conservatory with a strong modern and contemporary name, and the 90-second solo round is a place where your choreography can carry you.
items.watch_out: The audition is ballet first, admission rides mostly on that one audition day, and as a Florida resident you would pay SUNY out-of-state tuition.

items.name: University of Southern California, Glorya Kaufman School of Dance
items.prescreen_deadline: 2026-12-01 (USC Kaufman Portfolio with two video auditions)
items.audition: Submit the USC application and the Kaufman Portfolio, which includes two video auditions, by December 1, hear back in mid-December, and finalists are invited to live auditions in January 2027 (exact dates not on the page).
items.scholarships: You are automatically considered for USC merit awards (Trustee is full tuition, Presidential is half) and for separate Kaufman dance talent scholarships, and dance applicants must apply by December 1 to be considered for both.
items.why_john: USC wants versatile dancers who create, and your mix of contemporary, hip hop and your own choreography fits what they recruit for.
items.watch_out: They take about 24 dancers a year, USC's sticker price is very high without merit money, and the merit details on their site come from a page labeled 2024-25, so confirm the amounts.

items.name: Point Park University
items.program: BFA in Dance (modern concentration; ballet, jazz and hip hop also offered)
items.app_deadline: Rolling; send materials and audition by 2027-03-15 for the best shot at Conservatory merit scholarships
items.audition: In person on campus Nov 14 or Dec 5, 2026, or Feb 14 or 27, 2027; in New York City Jan 16, 2027 at Open Jar Studios; or in Chicago Nov 6, 2026 at the CNADM fair. You book through Accept'd after your academic application is in, and the fee is $150.
items.scholarships: Conservatory merit scholarships and talent awards are tied to the March 15, 2027 date, and Point Park sends full aid packages after you are admitted academically and artistically.
items.why_john: Point Park lets you put your main focus on modern while still training jazz and hip hop, which matches how many styles you already dance.
items.watch_out: The $150 review fee is steep (waivers exist if money is tight), rolling admission fills up, and the page lists no talent award amounts.

items.name: Northeastern University New York City (formerly Marymount Manhattan College)
items.program: BFA in Dance (concentrations in ballet, choreography, jazz or modern; a BA is also offered)
items.prescreen_deadline: Digital submissions, used instead of a live audition: ED I 2026-12-04, EA 2027-01-29, ED II 2027-02-12, RD 2027-03-12
items.app_deadline: Fall 2027 applicants apply straight to Northeastern through the Common App, which opened 2026-08-01. Round deadlines were not on the pages I read.
items.audition: In person at the NYC campus on Dec 6, 2026 (EA), Jan 23, 2027 (ED II and RD), Feb 20, 2027 or Mar 6, 2027 (RD), or at a regional audition in Oakland on Jan 17, 2027, with ballet, improv, modern and jazz plus a 2-minute solo. Digital submission is allowed but in-person is strongly encouraged.
items.why_john: This is the only school on this list with a full choreography concentration in the BFA, which is built for a dancer who already makes his own solos.
items.watch_out: The school is in the middle of merging into Northeastern in 2026-27, so call admissions to confirm deadlines and aid, and expect private New York tuition.

items.name: Boston Conservatory at Berklee
items.program: BFA in Dance: Contemporary Dance Performance
items.app_deadline: Nov 1 for Early Action, Dec 1 for Regular (the page lists no year; these are the fall 2027 cycle dates)
items.audition: Live audition with a ballet class, a modern class and your own solo (original choreography is allowed). EA-only dates: on campus Nov 14 or 21, 2026, online Dec 5, 2026, regionals in Atlanta Jan 3, Chicago Jan 5 and New York Jan 7 or 8, 2027, and on campus Jan 16, 2027. Open to all: Los Angeles Jan 24, on campus Jan 30 or Feb 6, and online Feb 13, 2027.
items.scholarships: Early Action applicants get admission and merit scholarship decisions by January 31, and Regular applicants hear about admission and financial aid by April 1.
items.why_john: The solo can be your own choreography, which plays straight to your strength, and Early Action gets you a scholarship answer by the end of January.
items.watch_out: To keep the early scholarship timing you need to apply by November 1 and audition by January 20 or 21 (the school's own pages give both dates), and Boston Conservatory is private-conservatory expensive.

items.name: University of North Carolina School of the Arts
items.app_deadline: 2027-01-20 final deadline; 2026-11-02 priority date (priority applicants get first pick of on-campus audition slots)
items.audition: On campus in Winston-Salem on 2027-01-30, 2027-02-06 or 2027-02-13, or a single video of 10 minutes or less (ballet barre plus a 1 to 2 minute self-choreographed solo to classical or art music), and documents are due two weeks before your audition.
items.scholarships: Talent awards are set by the dean of dance from your audition, and the top admits can be nominated for the Kenan Excellence Scholarship (full tuition, fees, room and board), but the dance page lists no dollar amounts for 2027.
items.why_john: John, they literally ask you to choreograph your own solo for the audition, so the thing you already do for competition is your way in.
items.watch_out: You pay out-of-state public tuition as a Florida resident, men need a dance belt and have to do a real ballet barre on video or in person, and NC residents get decisions first in mid-March.

items.name: California Institute of the Arts (CalArts)
items.app_deadline: 2026-12-01 preferred (reduced fee, every material must be in); 2027-01-05 regular
items.audition: Live auditions in Los Angeles 2027-01-09, Chicago 2027-01-16 and New York 2027-01-23 cover more than one technique plus a creative piece, or you can send a video (three ballet exercises, a traveling contemporary phrase, a self-choreographed solo).
items.why_john: CalArts cares more about the artist you are than about clean technique, and a kid who already makes his own solos and teaches little ones fits that exactly.
items.watch_out: It is a private art school with private-school cost, it is across the country in LA, and the video audition still asks for three ballet exercises.

items.name: Southern Methodist University, Meadows School of the Arts
items.app_deadline: 2026-11-01 Early Action / Early Decision I; 2027-01-15 Regular Decision / Early Decision II (separate Meadows Dance Application required too)
items.audition: On campus in Dallas 2026-10-31, 2026-11-21, 2027-01-30 or 2027-02-20, regionals in New York 2027-01-16 and Houston 2027-02-05, auditions at events like REVEL, NYCDA and BOCA, or recorded video due 2026-11-01 or 2027-02-01.
items.scholarships: To be considered for SMU's Presidents' Scholar or Hunt Leadership Scholar programs you have to finish the dance audition in the fall, and SMU says Jan 15 is the priority deadline for merit aid.
items.why_john: SMU wants equal ballet, modern and jazz, which fits a well-rounded competition dancer, and you could audition at a convention you're already going to.
items.watch_out: It is a private university with high sticker price, it is real about ballet, and the fall audition dates that unlock the big scholarships come early (2026-10-31 and 2026-11-21).

items.name: Indiana University Bloomington, Jacobs School of Music
items.app_deadline: 2026-11-01 preferred IU application; 2026-12-01 final IU application and Jacobs supplemental
items.audition: Send a prescreen video of up to 3 minutes (a solo plus a phrase in another style) by 2026-12-01, and if invited, come to campus on 2027-01-29, 2027-02-05 or 2027-02-26 for a two-hour class and a one-minute solo that can be self-choreographed or improvised.
items.scholarships: Every admitted Jacobs student is automatically considered for freshman talent scholarships based on the audition, and IU's own merit scholarship requires applying by 2026-11-01.
items.why_john: They tell you to bring tap shoes and sneakers and let your one-minute solo be your own choreography, so all the different styles you dance are a plus here instead of something you hide.
items.watch_out: You pay Big Ten out-of-state tuition, and the program just moved into the Jacobs School of Music, so confirm details with admissions before you plan around them.

items.name: University of Oklahoma, School of Dance
items.program: BFA in Modern Dance Performance (Ballet Performance is a separate track)
items.prescreen_deadline: 2026-12-11 for the 2027-02-06 audition (the 2026-10-01 deadline for the November audition has passed)
items.audition: Everyone sends a screening video first, callbacks go out by email (2026-12-19 for the winter round), and invited dancers take a full-day live campus audition on 2027-02-06 with a short faculty interview, with modern and ballet both auditionable the same day.
items.why_john: Go for the modern track, not ballet, because that's where your contemporary strength and your own choreography count the most.
items.watch_out: OU is known for ballet, so make sure you're applying to modern, you pay out-of-state tuition, and the fall round is already closed, so the 2026-12-11 video is your one shot.

items.name: University of Utah, School of Dance
items.program: BFA in Contemporary Dance (formerly BFA in Modern Dance)
items.app_deadline: University deadlines start around December 1; the school says apply early
items.audition: In person at the Marriott Center for Dance in Salt Lake City on 2026-11-14 or 2027-02-13 (each date closes when it fills), with a $50 fee, and a rolling video option due by April 1 only if you can't attend.
items.scholarships: The school says applying to the university early improves your odds at admission offers and scholarships, and it has its own dance scholarships page with details.
items.why_john: This is one of the oldest modern dance programs in the country, and it just renamed itself Contemporary to cover more styles, which is right where you live as a dancer.
items.watch_out: You pay out-of-state tuition, Salt Lake is a long trip for an in-person audition, and both dates can fill up and close early.

items.name: Western Michigan University
items.app_deadline: Audition materials in and university acceptance by January 31 to be considered for dance scholarships (no other date posted)
items.audition: On campus 2026-11-20 or 2027-02-26, rolling virtual auditions through April 1, or off-site at the CNADM fair in Schaumburg IL on 2026-11-06, Detroit on 2026-11-07, or the National High School Dance Festival in Pittsburgh on 2027-03-06 to 07.
items.scholarships: To be considered for dance scholarships you need your audition materials in and university acceptance by January 31, and they encourage the FAFSA for need-based aid.
items.why_john: WMU is a well-known jazz program that also takes modern and contemporary seriously, so you'd get to use every style you have, not just one.
items.watch_out: You pay out-of-state tuition, Michigan winters are a shock coming from Orlando, and you have to get admitted separately by both the university and the dance program.

items.name: Temple University, Boyer College of Music and Dance (UArts replacement)
items.app_deadline: Early Action November 1, Regular Decision February 1 (Temple's standing dates, 2026-27 cycle not confirmed); your Temple application has to be submitted before you can audition
items.audition: In person at Pearson-McGonigle Hall in Philadelphia on 2026-12-05, 2027-01-30, 2027-02-13 or 2027-04-03 with a workshop (modern, ballet, African diasporic), a self-choreographed solo of 1:00 to 1:30, and a faculty interview, or a video through Acceptd ($35) since you live more than 150 miles away.
items.scholarships: First-years who apply by Feb 1 are automatically considered for merit aid, Temple lists $10,000 to $20,000 a year for out-of-state students, and some colleges factor in artistic talent.
items.why_john: Temple is the strongest Philly program left now that UArts is gone, and the audition is built around your own solo plus a conversation about why you made it, which is exactly how you think as a choreographer.
items.watch_out: UArts closed in 2024, and Temple took in more than 350 former UArts students but runs its own program with no UArts teach-out for dance, you pay out-of-state public tuition, and the BFA is concert dance only, with no commercial or competition focus.

items.name: The Ohio State University
items.app_deadline: Dance audition application due 2026-10-16 (autumn) or 2027-01-16 (winter or video); university Early Action 2026-11-01 for merit scholarships, Regular 2027-01-15
items.audition: In person in Columbus with a recommended Friday visit day and a required Saturday audition on 2026-10-31 or 2027-01-30, or a video audition with videos due 2027-01-23.
items.scholarships: Applying Early Action by 2026-11-01 puts you in line for university merit scholarships, Feb 1 is the priority date for FAFSA and university scholarships, and dance scholarships are awarded in March or April.
items.why_john: Ohio State is a big research-university dance department that's serious about making new work, so your choreography could really grow there alongside your dancing.
items.watch_out: The autumn audition application is due 2026-10-16, you pay out-of-state tuition, and you need separate admission from both the university and the dance department.

items.name: Pace University
items.prescreen_deadline: January 4 (Pace's posted prescreen deadline; no year printed, but the page is for the fall 2027 cycle)
items.app_deadline: Early Decision November 1 (audition must happen before December 1); final deadline December 1, no applications accepted after
items.audition: You apply to Pace first, then upload the prescreen on Acceptd (headshot, resume, two full-body photos including first arabesque, a solo under 2 minutes, and recordings of Pace's ballet and jazz combos), and invited dancers get a live callback in ballet, jazz, tap and hip hop.
items.scholarships: Merit scholarships up to $33,000 a year, plus artistic scholarships from the audition; admitted Sands students are reviewed for aid on talent, grades and need together (2025-26 tuition was $62,040).
items.why_john: This is the program built for a kid who can switch from jazz to hip hop to tap in one afternoon, and your competition polish is exactly what that callback room is looking for.
items.watch_out: New York private-school cost is steep even with the merit cap, and the prescreen wants a first arabesque photo and a ballet combo, so your ballet has to look clean on camera.

items.name: Oklahoma City University (Ann Lacy School of American Dance and Entertainment)
items.program: Bachelor of Performing Arts in Dance Performance (also BS in Dance Management)
items.app_deadline: Start the OCU academic application by 2026-10-14 (October audition), 2027-01-21 (January) or 2027-03-25 (April)
items.audition: On campus over two required days (Dance with the Stars Day plus Audition Day): 2026-10-23/24 (registration due 2026-10-14), 2027-01-29/30 (register by 2027-01-19), or 2027-04-02/03 (register by 2027-03-23), with tap, jazz and ballet classes and a 1-minute solo; video auditions by arrangement.
items.scholarships: Talent scholarships are awarded through the audition and can stack with academic merit up to block tuition, and the October Advantage Audition gets earlier decisions and access to more dance scholarship money.
items.why_john: OCU trains tap, jazz and ballet every day for the entertainment industry and even has a Men's Technical Studies class, so your range and stage presence fit how they build dancers.
items.watch_out: The October Advantage registration closes 2026-10-14, so if that is missed the January audition is the realistic target, and you need an ACT 21, SAT 1060 or 3.33 GPA to be eligible.

items.name: Elon University
items.program: BFA in Dance Performance and Choreography
items.prescreen_deadline: Not posted for fall 2027; Elon's audition info on Acceptd still shows the 2025-26 cycle
items.app_deadline: University: Early Decision and Early Action 2026-11-01, Early Decision II 2027-01-15, Regular 2027-01-10 (final)
items.audition: Dance applicants complete a separate Acceptd application and audition for the department, and Elon has not yet posted its 2026-27 dance audition dates.
items.why_john: Elon puts choreography at the center of the degree, so a dancer who already makes his own competition solos would get two full choreography courses and real stage time for his work.
items.watch_out: Required advanced levels are ballet, contemporary modern and West African with jazz and tap only as electives, and the BFA Music Theatre is a separate, very competitive audition that also needs singing and acting.

items.name: Montclair State University
items.prescreen_deadline: No date posted; prescreen (2 to 3 minute modern or contemporary solo, plus an optional second style) is reviewed only after both recommendation letters arrive
items.audition: After the prescreen, an in-person (about 1 to 6 pm) or virtual audition with a contemporary class, group improv and a 1-minute contemporary solo, or skip the prescreen by auditioning through a 2026-27 partner: NYCDA, The Dance Awards, Revel, Dance Forward, Dancewave or GTen Global.
items.scholarships: Artistic merit comes from the audition (audition by the end of January for the strongest consideration), and a 3.0 GPA gets automatic academic merit review with no separate application.
items.why_john: Your lyrical and contemporary are your strongest work, and you may be able to audition right at a Dance Awards or NYCDA event instead of a separate trip.
items.watch_out: This is a contemporary-first program, so your jazz, hip hop and tap count for less here, and 2026-27 campus audition dates were not found on the site.

items.name: Shenandoah University (Shenandoah Conservatory)
items.app_deadline: Submit the Shenandoah application before your audition; no fixed deadline posted
items.audition: On campus on 2026-10-30, 2026-11-20, 2027-01-29 or 2027-02-19: ballet, contemporary/modern and commercial jazz classes, a creative exercise, a 90-second solo and a short faculty interview, with résumé, headshot and dance photo uploaded when you register.
items.scholarships: Every auditioner is automatically considered for a renewable conservatory talent scholarship, offers usually come by April 1, and you must audition by February to be fully considered.
items.why_john: They encourage first-year applicants to choreograph their own 90-second solo, which is exactly what you already do, and the class mixes commercial jazz with ballet and contemporary.
items.watch_out: No tap and no classical ballet variations allowed in the solo, so pick your contemporary or jazz piece.

items.name: AMDA College of the Performing Arts
items.program: BFA in Dance Theatre (Los Angeles campus)
items.app_deadline: Rolling admission; AMDA suggests completing your file 60 to 90 days before your start date
items.audition: Campus, national tour, live virtual or recorded video auditions with two contrasting dance solos of about 60 seconds each, and BFA dance applicants must show classical or contemporary ballet technique.
items.scholarships: Merit scholarships are tied to the audition (you must be a high school junior or senior to qualify), and need-based aid is also offered.
items.why_john: AMDA trains dancers for Broadway, commercial and screen work in LA, so your hip hop and jazz are as useful as your contemporary.
items.watch_out: The official AMDA pages blocked our reader, so dates and current costs are unconfirmed, and the dance BFA is on the LA campus while New York offers a certificate route.

items.name: Rider University
items.app_deadline: Early Action November 15 for audition-based programs; no dance-specific deadline posted
items.audition: Dance needs only a solo video under 2 minutes in any style, uploaded to the Be A Bronc dashboard for class placement, and it does not affect your admission.
items.why_john: Rider gets you into a dance major without a make-or-break audition while you still get choreography, repertory and main-stage concerts, a safe-bet school that still keeps you dancing.
items.watch_out: It is a BA rather than a conservatory BFA, so expect fewer studio hours, and no dance-specific talent scholarship is listed.

items.name: California State University, Long Beach
items.program: BA in Dance, with BFA in Dance by a later audition
items.prescreen_deadline: Video audition instructions by request from dance@csulb.edu after you apply; no deadline posted
items.app_deadline: 2026-11-30 (Cal State Apply, opened 2026-10-01), then email dance@csulb.edu for the Dance Audition Application
items.audition: On campus Friday 2027-02-26 (9am or 1pm session), a faculty-led class with phrase work in modern, ballet, jazz and street/club dance where you choose two.
items.why_john: You can show off in your two best styles, and street/club is one of the options, which plays straight to your hip hop.
items.watch_out: Every freshman enters the BA and has to audition again for the BFA after required courses with a 3.0, and as a Florida resident you would pay CSU out-of-state tuition.

items.name: Chapman University
items.program: BA in Dance, with BFA in Dance Performance by application sophomore year
items.prescreen_deadline: Submitted with the Creative Supplement by your application deadline; Chapman recommends talent applicants apply by 2026-11-01
items.app_deadline: Early Action and Early Decision I 2026-11-01; Early Decision II and Regular 2027-01-15
items.audition: Prescreen video (an intro under 60 seconds plus a 2-minute solo showing floor work, jumps, balance and travel), then select applicants are invited to a live audition in person or virtual, and if you are not invited live the prescreen is your final audition.
items.scholarships: Talent Awards are set from your Creative Supplement, prescreen and live audition, with no separate scholarship application.
items.why_john: Chapman lets you send a self-choreographed solo, so your Grand Champion piece can do the talking in the prescreen.
items.watch_out: You only start in the BA and must apply for the BFA in the spring of sophomore year, and it carries a private-school price tag.

items.name: The Ailey School
items.program: Certificate Program (Professional Division), plus the Scholarship Program
items.prescreen_deadline: 2027-05-04 (school year video audition deadline, only if he auditions by video)
items.app_deadline: In-person audition registration and video submission open 2026-11-17; in-person audition tour runs January to April 2027; video deadline 2027-05-04
items.audition: He can audition in person on the January to April 2027 tour or upload a video through the Admissions Portal, with a $30 fee.
items.scholarships: The separate Scholarship Program (ages 17 to 21, by audition) charges recipients only $720 a year for Level 1 tuition, and Certificate students who qualify can get federal financial aid, but scholarship recipients cannot also get federal aid.
items.why_john: Ailey wants dancers with real stage presence and range, so your solo and choreography experience would show here.
items.watch_out: The age range is 17 to 23 and you only have to be 17 by the program start, so you qualify, but it is three years, heavy on ballet and modern (at least three years of each required), aimed at experienced beginner to intermediate students, 2026-27 tuition was $16,682 plus fees (2027-28 not set yet), there is no degree, and you pay for NYC housing yourself.

items.name: Joffrey Ballet School
items.program: NYC Trainee Program, Jazz & Contemporary track (Post-Secondary Certificate for high school grads)
items.app_deadline: Digital trainee auditions are accepted throughout the year; no 2027-28 deadline posted
items.audition: He can audition in person in NYC, at a Summer Intensive audition city, or by digital video at any time of year; the general audition fee is $43 to $47.
items.scholarships: Merit scholarships come from the audition and must be reapplied for every year, and need-based aid requires the FAST application.
items.why_john: The Jazz & Contemporary track includes choreography and improvisation, which matches how you already make your own solos.
items.watch_out: The age rule is at least 13 by the audition and no older than 25 on September 1, so you are fine, but 2026-27 tuition was $25,900 a year plus $22,000 for the optional dorm and about $1,700 in yearly fees, there is no degree unless you add the paid BFA option, and the page names two different BFA partner schools.

items.name: Peridance Center
items.app_deadline: For Fall 2026 the domestic deadline was June 30, 2026; Fall 2027 dates not posted
items.audition: He can audition live or by video ($30 fee); the Commercial video is two 64-count exercises plus two solos, sent with a headshot, resume, two recommendation letters, an essay and proof of graduation.
items.scholarships: Every applicant is automatically considered during the audition, and second-year renewal is not guaranteed.
items.why_john: The Commercial track mixes contemporary, jazz, hip hop and theatre dance, so it fits how versatile you already are.
items.watch_out: The age range is 17 to 25 and you need your diploma by the start date, so you qualify; listed tuition for Fall 2025 starters was $15,200 domestic plus $375 in fees, it lasts two years with no degree, and the housing wording is mixed, so ask before you count on it.

items.name: Broadway Dance Center
items.app_deadline: 2027-07-02 for the Fall 2027 session (Aug 30 to Dec 17, 2027); 2026-11-16 for Spring 2027
items.audition: The online application needs the required audition combination videos, a 30 to 60 second intro video, a 30 to 60 second reel, a headshot, a resume and a $50 fee; the only in-person audition posted is October 25, 2026 in NYC, and it is for Fall 2026 or Spring 2027.
items.scholarships: One full-semester Stephanie Bissonnette Legacy Scholarship is given each year, plus the BDC Scholarship Fund for dancers of color; you check the interest box on the application.
items.why_john: It is four months of daily classes, mock auditions and an industry showcase in NYC, a fast way to get seen by agents.
items.watch_out: The program says Ages 18+, and you turn 18 on October 13, 2027, after the Fall 2027 start, so Spring 2028 is probably the earliest term you could join (confirm with BDC); it also needs 10 or more years of training, tuition was $5,750 for 2025, NYC housing is on you, and there is no degree.

items.name: Steps on Broadway
items.app_deadline: Fall 2026 deadline was 2026-03-01; Fall 2027 deadline not posted yet
items.audition: He applies on Acceptd and then either sends video (both-sides ballet technique, a solo up to 3 minutes and 16 to 32 bars of singing) or books an on-site class audition after applying, with a $60 fee.
items.scholarships: Every applicant is considered for partial merit scholarships that cover tuition only (no full rides); 529 funds work, FAFSA does not.
items.why_john: Steps trains you for both concert and commercial work, so your contemporary and jazz both get used.
items.watch_out: The age range is 17 to 24 and you need your diploma before the semester starts, so you qualify; tuition is $14,750 a year ($29,500 total) with a $3,000 deposit, a singing video is part of the video audition, housing is not guaranteed, and there is no degree.

items.name: Millennium Dance Complex
items.app_deadline: No deadline listed; posted start dates run only through 2026-12-28, nothing for 2027 yet
items.audition: There is no audition: he sends a dance video link, headshot, dance photo, recommendation letter and personal statement with a $50 fee, then picks a 2 to 12 month length.
items.why_john: It puts you in LA's commercial class scene every day, at least 10 classes a week, so choreographers can see your hip hop and jazz.
items.watch_out: No age minimum is stated for the Certificate (the separate Work-Study Program requires 18 and a 12-month commitment); it costs $2,400 for 2 months up to $14,400 for 12, you take open classes rather than a set curriculum, housing is extra through LA Dance Dorms, there are no refunds and no degree.

items.name: AMDA College of the Performing Arts (Los Angeles)
items.audition: He can audition live or by video with 2 contrasting dance solos of about 60 seconds each, and has to ask his Admissions Advisor for the video submission form.
items.scholarships: Every audition is considered for merit scholarships.
items.why_john: You can audition with two solos in your own styles, which plays to your Grand Champion competition material.
items.watch_out: High school seniors can audition now and there is no age minimum beyond that, but the official certificate page and a 2027 deadline could not be confirmed, third-party guides list tuition around $49,500 (unverified), and Hollywood housing costs a lot.
